notes: Four corrections found in review. studio_delete is not the only direct apply tool (studio_export and change_apply are both direct+apply); the count was sixteen and is seventeen with rail_open, which had no bullet; delete's dangling-reference note is on the description always but on the receipt only for referenceable kinds (delete.ts REFERENCEABLE); folder_search also reaches the studio as a standing grant. Also corrects the falsified symlink claim: entries are skipped during traversal, and the resolved path is now reconciled against realpath, which is what actually closes it.
